subject: E-Commerce
title: Honest Scarcity Works Better
description: A short lesson to help you apply Honest Scarcity Works Better.

hook.text: Real scarcity works 3x better than fake scarcity. Shoppers can smell dishonesty, and backlash is expensive.

buildup.text: When scarcity is genuine—limited edition, seasonal, or handmade—shoppers feel special, not manipulated.

discovery.text: Patagonia's 'Don't Buy This Jacket' ad increased sales 30%. Honesty became the best marketing strategy.

twist.text: Everlane shows factory costs alongside retail prices. 'Radical transparency' became a competitive advantage.

climax.text: Ethical brands grow faster among younger consumers. Trust is the new currency in e-commerce.

punchline.text: 'Don't Buy This Jacket' boosted sales 30%. Honesty sells better than tricks.
